title: Bracket Count
statement: A code formatter wants to know how many different strings of n pairs of brackets are balanced (every "(" is closed by a later ")" and no prefix has more ")" than "("). Return that number.

answerKey.pattern: Backtracking with counts of open and close brackets
keyPoints: Add "(" while fewer than n are open
Add ")" only when it would not exceed the opens so far
Count when the string has 2n characters
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Generate all 2^(2n) strings and check each: much slower

hints: When may you add a closing bracket?
Only when more "(" than ")" have been placed so far.
Recurse on (open, close); add "(" while open < n, ")" while close < open; count at length 2n.
